name: HyperVault AI data centre campus
status_note: TCS unit HyperVault and partners (incl. TPG) to invest up to ₹700bn (~$7.4B) in a 1 GW campus on ~264 acres; phased build, construction targeted for early 2027 (announced Sep 2026).

sources.title: India's TCS unit to invest up to $7.4 billion in AI data center campus
TCS' HyperVault makes ₹70,000 crore AI infrastructure play with 1 GW Hyderabad campus

review_notes: Exact site within Hyderabad not yet published. Construction timing reported inconsistently (start vs completion early 2027).
